questions.question: Filing class for Local's gaps C1–C7 (conform.py at 94a5bec reproduces all seven). RFC-0024 R4/R5 and process Rule 3 say a difference between a v1 decision and 0.33 is a break record or a 0.33 defect; a BUG (class K) is 0.33 code against its OWN spec. Only C3 and C4 meet that: Local's read() returns a bare file, so raw OSError leaks from a read and from close() (BE-021 'never leak', precedent BUG-334). C1, C2, C5 are unspecified in 0.33; C6/C7 contradict SIO-001/SIO-008, which make Local, SFTP and S3 boto3 read() seekable. How should they be filed?

options.label: K/break split (Recommended)
options.description: One BUG for C3+C4 (one cause: no error mapping on Local's stream). One BK item, like BK-469, for OP-01's D8 comparison holding C1, C2, C5, C6/C7 with repro, decisions, clauses; BRK rows born once OP-01's spec gives clause IDs. 2 IDs.

options.label: One item per gap
options.description: BUG for C3 and C4 separately, BK for each break (C1, C2, C5, C6/C7): about 6 IDs, each saying it becomes a BRK row or K item at D8's pass.

options.label: BUG for all, as briefed
options.description: Seven (or six) BUG items. C6/C7 'fixes' would break 0.33's own SEEKABLE_READ contract on Local/SFTP/S3 boto3, against RFC-0024 R4/R5.

questions.question: C6 (seekable() is True) and C7 (seek(0) works): fold into one entry? D70 decides both (seekable() false; seek raises io.UnsupportedOperation), D93/D153 restate them, and one cause produces both (the raw file is seekable).

options.label: Fold (Recommended)
options.description: One entry/row for C6 and C7, citing D70, D93, D153 and clauses S13, S14.

options.label: Keep separate
options.description: Two entries, one per method, each with its own repro and clause.

questions.question: New finding outside C1–C7, measured offline (real azure-storage-blob _ChunkIterator, fake downloader, injected fault): after one failed chunk download, Azure read()'s next read skips that chunk with no error (16 of 20 bytes delivered, not a prefix), and an azure-core ServiceResponseError leaks unmapped from the stream. File it?

options.label: File a new BUG (Recommended)
options.description: One BUG: silent gap plus BE-021 leak on Azure read(); a 0.33 defect, separate mechanism from BUG-346 (SDK iterator, not BufferedReader.readline).

options.label: Fold into BUG-346
options.description: Extend BUG-346 (same symptom family: bytes lost after a mid-stream failure); its wrapper decision would cover both.

options.label: Report only
options.description: Record it in the report and trace's discovery notes, no backlog item.

Where do the two blocking ones go besides the report?
